relations.text: アンテロのオハイオ資産を共同買収(NOG40%・INR60%で運営)
relations.text_en: Co-bought Antero's Ohio assets; INR holds 60% and operates

source.quote: At closing, the Company acquired a 40 % undivided working interest in the assets sold by Antero, with Infinity Natural Resources, LLC, an unaffiliated third party, acquiring the other 60 % and becoming the operator of the acquired assets.
